csp.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
csp.shared_resp: AWS is responsible for the security OF the cloud (physical data centers, hardware, hypervisor, networking infrastructure, managed-service backplane). The customer is responsible for security IN the cloud (identity, encryption configuration, logging, network controls, application code, data classification, and governance).

foundational_services.name: AWS CloudTrail
foundational_services.blurb: API audit log. Enable an organization trail with log file validation and KMS-encrypted destination.

foundational_services.name: AWS Config
foundational_services.blurb: Configuration state and history with Conformance Packs.

foundational_services.name: AWS Artifact
foundational_services.blurb: Inherited evidence — AWS SOC 2 Type II report.

purpose_paragraph: This minimal example demonstrates the build_evidence_package.py builder by mapping a small subset of SOC 2 criteria to AWS-native evidence sources. Intended for sanity-testing the skill, not for production use.

evidence_sourcing_principles.name: Authoritative source.
evidence_sourcing_principles.body: Pull evidence from the AWS service that owns the control. Avoid screenshots when an export or API call returns the same data.

evidence_sourcing_principles.name: Timestamped and immutable.
evidence_sourcing_principles.body: Send CloudTrail and Config to S3 buckets with Object Lock or versioning + MFA Delete.

evidence_sourcing_principles.name: Frequency-aligned.
evidence_sourcing_principles.body: Type 2 evaluates operating effectiveness across the audit period — use continuous detective controls.

rows.name: Logical access security software and architecture
rows.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events to meet the entity's objectives.
rows.services: AWS IAM; IAM Identity Center; AWS Organizations SCPs/RCPs; AWS KMS; AWS Secrets Manager; Amazon VPC
rows.evidence: Asset inventory from Systems Manager and Config; IAM policy JSON for production roles; SCP/RCP JSON; KMS key policies and rotation status.
rows.path: IAM -> Account settings; KMS -> Customer managed keys

rows.name: Restrict transmission, movement, and removal of information
rows.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized users and processes, and protects it during transmission, movement, or removal.
rows.services: AWS Certificate Manager; AWS PrivateLink; Amazon VPC endpoints; AWS KMS
rows.evidence: ACM certificate inventory; ALB/CloudFront TLS policy (TLS 1.2+); VPC endpoint inventory; KMS-encrypted S3 buckets list.

rows.name: Environmental protections, backup, recovery infrastructure
rows.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet its objectives.
rows.services: AWS Backup; Multi-AZ; Multi-Region; Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication
rows.evidence: AWS Backup plan with cross-region copy enabled; Multi-AZ deployment evidence; S3 CRR configuration; RTO/RPO documentation.
rows.path: Backup -> Backup plans; S3 -> Bucket -> Management -> Replication

inherited.why: Physical access to AWS data centers is operated and controlled by AWS.
inherited.evidence: AWS SOC 2 Type II report (AWS Artifact -> Reports). Customer evidences physical controls for non-AWS components only.
Active subscription to AWS SOC 2 Type II report; carve-out or inclusive method documented.

evidence_retention_bullets: Retain CloudTrail logs for the audit period plus one year, in an S3 bucket with Object Lock and KMS-CMK encryption.
Run AWS Backup restore tests quarterly.
references: AICPA TSP Section 100 (2017 TSC with revised Points of Focus, 2022)
